summary_1line: Hanuman explores Ravana’s opulent palace and beholds the magnificent aerial chariot Pushpaka filled with jeweled, lifelike sculptures and celestial splendor.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman stands on a palace height gazing at the radiant Pushpaka chariot hovering above jeweled buildings of Lanka.
The Pushpaka chariot gleams with gold, coral, and emerald birds and serpents while sculpted elephants shower water upon the seated goddess Lakshmi.
Within Ravana’s palace, halls glitter with heaps of jewels, golden couches, and musicians while beautiful women move among the treasures.
